title: fix(ui): phone list card shows its amount whole; field-tab strip scrolls at phone width
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Fixes #34615
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手机列表卡片把金额（第一个 `currency` 列）从副标题里拿出来，单独放在副标题下面一行的右侧、完整显示，状态徽标移到这一行左侧；表单字段页签条在手机宽度（`sm` 以下）不再撑宽页面，放不下的页签横向滑动、不显示滚动条，当前页签始终滚到可见处。
- 为什么改：375 宽下商机卡片的金额和客户名平分一行，「CN¥1,200,000.00」被截成「CN¥1,2…」；5 个页签的编辑表单整条页签超出弹窗，页面出现横向滚动（维护者专题 #34571「都是p1」）。
- 风险与回滚：只影响手机布局：卡片只在手机上画，页签条新增的样式全部带 `max-sm:` 前缀，桌面表格与页签外观不变；没有金额列的列表卡片与原来一样。回滚即还原本 PR 两个源文件。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`（`amountCol` 的选取规则与金额行）、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`（页签条 `max-sm:` 样式与把当前页签滚入可见区的 effect）、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-field-tabs.test.tsx`，预期两个文件全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

**Phone list card (`buildMobileCardRenderer`).** The card's amount is now the first shown body column whose resolved field type is `currency` (the column draft's `type`; no new metadata key). It no longer takes a subtitle slot. When the list has such a column, every card draws an amount line under the subtitle: the status chip on the left (`min-w-0 truncate`) and the amount on the right (`ml-auto shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums`, drawn through the column's own desktop cell, so the currency rules of objectui#10423 still hold). The subtitle takes the next shown column instead. A masked amount column is not promoted. A list with no currency column keeps the objectstack#28484 row unchanged (chip at the right), and its pins still pass untouched.

**Form field-tab strip (`fieldTabs`).** I took the scroll route rather than a 「More」 menu. The scroll route meets acceptance 2 with no i18n key, no overflow measurement and no second control to keep in sync with the error markers. Below `sm` the horizontal strip gets `max-w-full overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden justify-start`, with no scrollbar drawn (`[scrollbar-width:none]` and `[&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden`, the idiom `record-path.tsx` and `studio-tokens.ts` already use). An effect keyed on the active tab moves only the strip's own `scrollLeft` so the active trigger is inside its window. That covers a tap, `defaultFieldTab`, and a failed submit jumping to the first offending tab, whose red dot rides on the trigger. A strip that fits (every desktop strip) is never touched. Vertical strips are unchanged.

Before/after, real rendered DOM measured in Chromium (method under Verification):

| 375 px | base `62d9d0d9` | head |
|:---|:---|:---|
| card amount `CN¥1,200,000.00` | in subtitle, box 75.2 px of 104 px: clipped | own line, 121.6 px of 122 px: whole |
| card amount `CN¥94,000.00` (long account name) | box 42.6 px of 85 px: clipped | whole |
| page horizontal overflow | 165 px | 0 px |
| 5-tab strip | 523.8 px wide, overflow visible, past the 359 px dialog edge | 343 px (= dialog), `overflow-x: auto`, `scrollbar-width: none`, scrollWidth 524 > clientWidth 343 |
| 5th tab reachable + error dot visible after the scroll | n/a (page scrolls) | yes / yes |

At 1280 px the strip measures 523.8 px with `overflow-x: visible` on both trees: desktop is unchanged.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx` (375 px): full amount text in its own slot with no truncating box between it and the card; amount out of the subtitle; chip at the left of the amount line; a row with no amount keeps the shape; control without a currency column keeps the objectstack#28484 row.
- `form-field-tabs.test.tsx` gains a top-level `describe` (the shared field-tabs harness, per the shared-harness rule): phone-gated classes, with no ungated `overflow-*` / `max-w-*` tokens; the vertical strip is left alone; tap, failed submit and `defaultFieldTab` each scroll the 5th tab into a stubbed 343 px strip; control: a strip that fits is never scrolled. jsdom has no layout engine, so the geometry is stubbed there and was measured in Chromium once (below).
- `mobileCardFieldCurrency-10423.test.tsx` reads the amount from `grid-card-amount` instead of the first subtitle part (the same assertion, at the slot the amount now occupies).

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation landed on disk via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, then restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- `amountCol` predicate → `false`: 10 red / 4 green (all four 34615 card cases and the six 10423 card-amount cases red; the 34615 control and the three 10423 desktop controls green), as predicted.
- Tab effect `trigger` → `null`: tap, failed-submit and `defaultFieldTab` cases red, 3 green (classes, vertical, fits-control), as predicted.
- Phone classes line → `''`: the class case red, the rest green, as predicted.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 and 2 were measured at 375 px on the real rendered DOM of these components (jsdom render dumped to HTML, Tailwind v4 compiled from the classes present, Chromium at 375 x 812), not in a running Console with the CRM 商机 metadata. A permanent geometry pin in the `ui/e2e` Playwright style would sit outside this claim's file surface, so this PR does not add one.
- On the scroll route, a second errored tab that is not the active one shows its dot once it is swiped into view. A failed submit always activates and scrolls to the first offending tab.
- A vertical (`left`/`right`) field-tab strip on a phone is unchanged. It was not part of this card.
- Docs: no page under `content/docs/**` or the two package READMEs describes the card's layout or the strip's overflow, so nothing published became false.
